{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove any non-numeric characters (e.g., commas or currency symbols)
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('[^0-9.]+', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Calculate mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Output result
print(mean_revenue)"}
